name: architecture-refactoring
description: The standing architecture and dependency-injection rule set: responsibility-based folders and file names, 250-line files, 25-line methods, 8-line loop bodies, constructor injection, one composition root, polymorphism instead of behaviour-selection branching, discoverable typed public APIs, localized constants, dead-code protocol, and the anti-overengineering brakes that stop all of it turning into ceremony.
